verbatim.description: true = the quote appears in the paragraph word for word, ignoring only whitespace differences, curly vs straight quotes and dashes, and '…' marking an omission

closest_match.description: the paragraph's most similar passage (verbatim from the paragraph); null when the paragraph is not found

anyOf.description: readable name of the paragraph, for display and citing: '§79' for a numbered paragraph; 'Law, para 2' for an unnumbered one (n counts within that section of the document, in order); 'Article 8' for legislation. The stable id is paragraph_id

para_label.description: the paragraph's readable label; null when the paragraph is not found

anyOf.description: ready-to-paste citation '[<case name>, <doc type label>, <para_label>]', e.g. '[Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, §79]' or '[Harkins and Edwards v. the United Kingdom, Legal summary, Law, para 2]'. Copy it verbatim after the claim it supports; when two paragraphs of one result would share a string, the doc id is added to the doc type, e.g. 'Judgment (001-58004)'

scope.description: e.g. 'UK cases only (plus the Convention and the Human Rights Act 1998)'

sample_note.description: snapshot mode: 'Small committed sample, not the full HUDOC download.'; full mode: null

corpus.description: what the corpus covers: 'not found here' does not mean the Court never decided it

McpCheckQuoteResult.description: check_quote result: deterministic, no model involved
